objectives: Explain why Sarai gave Hagar to Abram and what followed.
Describe the prophecy over Ishmael and his posterity.
takeaways: Hagar was the Egyptian handmaid from the servants Pharaoh gave (Genesis 12:16).
When Hagar conceived she grew high minded; Abram's purpose was the seed, not multiple wives. Do not use this to justify taking multiple wives.
The angel sent Hagar back: return to thy mistress and submit thyself under her hands.
Ishmael would be a wild man, his hand against every man, dwelling in the presence of all his brethren.
Ishmael was Abram's firstborn, but the covenant goes through the twelve tribes of Israel.
